connector.name: TokenKnows
connector.registryDescription: Distill AI coding sessions into weekly reports, ADRs and a knowledge graph - self-hosted
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package tokenknows-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the johnnywuj81 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TOKENKNOWS_API_TOKEN
env.description: API token (tkk_...) or JWT bearer for the backend; create one in the web UI under Project Settings - MCP Access (optional for default local deployments)

env.name: TOKENKNOWS_DEFAULT_PROJECT
env.description: Default project_id for event submission and distill

env.name: TOKENKNOWS_WEB_BASE
env.description: Web UI base URL used to build view_url links returned by distill/list tools (login required to open them)
